title: equals, hashCode and the Object Contract
summary: What every class inherits from Object and the rules that come with it - equals and its five properties, why hashCode must agree with equals, compareTo consistent with equals, toString, what records write for you, and the bugs that appear in HashSet and HashMap when the rules are broken.

cards.q: Why must equal objects have equal hash codes?
cards.a: Hash-based collections look in the bucket chosen by `hashCode` first; an equal object with a different hash code is looked for in the wrong bucket and never found.

cards.q: Two different people compare as 0 in a `TreeSet`'s comparator. What happens?
cards.a: The set treats them as the same element and keeps only one.
